item.title: NIS Dismisses Claims Of Regional Exclusion In Passport Issuance
item.description: NIS says no region is barred from passport issuance, clarifying reforms involve phased migration to a centralised system.

item.title: NAF Plans Structured Retrieval Of Service Weapons From Retiring Officers
item.description: NAF plans transparent framework to retrieve service weapons from retiring officers, strengthen accountability and improve national security.

item.title: Cultists Kill Anambra Community Leader, One Other In Ogidi To Assuage Death Of Member
item.description: Suspected cultists kill Ogidi community leader and one other in reprisal attack linked to earlier death of cult member.

item.title: Habeebu: About 40% Of Cancers Are Preventable
item.description: Cancer specialist urges public education, early detection, and screening to cut Nigeria’s cancer burden.

item.title: Kano Assembly Denies Impeachment Plot Against Deputy Governor Gwarzo
item.description: Kano Assembly dismisses reports of impeachment moves against Deputy Governor Gwarzo as false and misleading.

item.title: US Lawmakers Condemn Nigeria Over $9m Lobbying Spend Amid Rising Religious Persecution
item.description: US lawmakers condemn Nigeria for spending $9m on Washington lobbyists instead of protecting citizens from religious persecution.

item.title: US Wants Russia And Ukraine To End War By June, Says Zelensky
item.description: US invites Ukraine and Russia to Miami talks as Zelensky warns 'difficult issues remained difficult' amid attacks.

item.title: Akpabio Defends Senate On Electoral Act Amendment, Warns Against Premature Criticism
item.description: Senate President Akpabio defends Electoral Act amendment, stressing process incomplete and cautioning against premature public criticism.

item.title: Wike Launches Radio Station In Rivers To Boost Tinubu’s 2027 Re-Election Campaign
item.description: FCT Minister Wike says Majority FM will mobilise Rivers grassroots for Tinubu, declaring readiness to push president’s re-election campaign ahead of 2027.

item.title: US Congressman Riley Moore Warns Destabilising Nigeria Could Embolden Terrorists
item.description: US lawmaker Moore says destabilising Nigeria would fuel terrorism and worsen risks for Christians, rejecting calls to balkanise the country.
